name: Capacitor, 0603 (1608 metric)
description: Generic MLCC family. Capacitance, dielectric, tolerance and voltage rating are properties of the BOM line, not of this entry: a design says '100n X7R 16V' and sourcing picks a manufacturer part. This entry fixes the package only.

source.note: The footprint's F.Fab outline is the 1.6 x 0.8 mm body (fp_line x -0.8..0.8, y -0.4..0.4); its descr names IPC-SM-782 page 76 as the body-size source via a pcb-3d.com PDF that returned 404 on 2026-09-06 (Internet Archive snapshot of 2025-04-28: https://web.archive.org/web/20250428122720/https://www.pcb-3d.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/ipc-sm-782a_amendment_1_and_2.pdf). The standard itself is not archived: no licence to redistribute it. C_0603_1608Metric.kicad_mod last changed in this commit (2020-09-23); KiCad libraries are CC-BY-SA-4.0. First entered 2026-08-15 from the same footprint. TODO(source): dielectric, tolerance and voltage ratings are vendor-specific and belong to a chosen MPN, not to the family.
